تنتزعين (form VIII)
# تَنْتَزِعِينَ (tantaziʕīna) /tan.ta.zi.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# تُنْتَزَعِينَ (tuntazaʕīna) /tun.ta.za.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
